text: Akakafiki ekhaya.
gloss: He hasn't arrived home yet.

text: Andikaze ndiye eMthatha.
gloss: I have never been to Mthatha.

text: Okokuqala, makhe sijonge ingxaki ngokwayo.
gloss: First, let's look at the problem itself.

text: Ngaphezu koko, iindleko zothutho zinyukile.
gloss: Moreover, transport costs have risen.

text: Ngoko ke, sifuna isicwangciso esitsha.
gloss: Therefore, we need a new plan.

text: Umzekelo, izikolo ezininzi azinathala leencwadi.
gloss: For example, many schools have no library.

text: Ekugqibeleni, intlanganiso iphele ngoxolo.
gloss: Finally, the meeting ended peacefully.

text: Ndicela uxolo ngokufika emva kwexesha.
gloss: I apologise for arriving late.

text: Ungandinceda ndithwale lo mthwalo?
gloss: Could you help me carry this load?

text: Wamkelekile, ziva usekhaya.
gloss: Welcome, feel at home.

text: Enkosi ngobubele bakho.
gloss: Thank you for your kindness.

text: Ndiyakuthuthuzela ngelahleko yakho.
gloss: I console you on your loss.

text: Ndifaka isicelo somsebenzi obhengezwe ephepheni.
gloss: I am applying for the job advertised in the newspaper.

text: Ndinomkhuhlane ukususela izolo ebusuku.
gloss: I have had flu since last night.

text: Ukugawulwa kwemithi kubangele imbalela kulo mmandla.
gloss: Tree felling has caused drought in this region.

text: Ngenye imini, umzingeli waya yedwa ehlathini.
gloss: One day, a hunter went into the forest alone.

text: Ngequbuliso, weva ilizwi elingaqhelekanga.
gloss: Suddenly, he heard an unusual voice.

text: Ulutsha luhlonela abadala ngokungababizi ngamagama.
gloss: Young people respect elders by not calling them by name.

text: Ulwaluko lusisithethe sokungena ebudodeni.
gloss: Initiation (ulwaluko) is the custom of entering manhood.

text: Ilobola ihlawulwa yintsapho yomyeni.
gloss: Lobola is paid by the groom's family.

text: Unentliziyo emhlophe.
gloss: He is kind-hearted.

text: Nangona uqoqosho lukhulile, abantu abaninzi basahlala kwintlupheko.
gloss: Although the economy has grown, many people still live in poverty.

text: Xa efika ekhaya, wafumanisa ukuba ucango luvuliwe.
gloss: When he arrived home, he found the door open.

text: Molweni.
gloss: Hello (to several people / respectful).

text: inyathi ibuzwa kwabaphambili
gloss: Ask about the buffalo from those ahead.

text: Nangona esi sicwangciso sinenjongo entle, ukuphunyezwa kwaso kubuthathaka.
gloss: Although this plan has good intentions, its implementation is weak.

text: Kucacile ukuba ngaphandle kwemfundo, inkqubela ayinakwenzeka.
gloss: It is clear that without education, progress cannot happen.

text: Ukuba urhulumente uyasilela ukulwa norhwaphilizo, abantu baza kuyeka ukumthemba.
gloss: If the government fails to fight corruption, people will stop trusting it.

text: Akukho mntu wayesazi ukuba kwenzeke ntoni.
gloss: No one knew what had happened.

text: Uthetha ngokungathi uyingcali.
gloss: He talks as though he were an expert.

text: Egameni lekomiti, ndidlulisa umbulelo omkhulu.
gloss: On behalf of the committee, I extend great thanks.

text: Ngobo busuku, ilali yonke yayithe cwaka.
gloss: That night, the whole village was silent.

text: Imbongi idumisa iinkosi ngezibongo.
gloss: The praise poet honours chiefs with praise poetry.

text: Umntu ngumntu ngabantu.
gloss: A person is a person through other people.

text: Inyathi ibuzwa kwabaphambili.
gloss: One asks about the buffalo from those ahead.

text: Izandla ziyahlambana.
gloss: Hands wash each other.

text: Kucacile ukuba lo mba ufuna ingxoxo enzulu.
gloss: It is clear that this matter needs a deep discussion.

text: Akuthandabuzeki ukuba ikamva lelizwe lixhomekeke kumgangatho wemfundo enikwa namhlanje.
gloss: Undoubtedly, the country's future depends on the quality of education given today.

text: Ukuba asifundi kwimbali, siza kuphinda iimpazamo ezifanayo.
gloss: If we don't learn from history, we will repeat the same mistakes.

text: Imbongi isebenzisa umlambo njengomqondiso wobomi obuguqukayo.
gloss: The poet uses the river as a symbol of changing life.

text: Iintsomi zigcina ubulumko nembali yesizwe.
gloss: Folktales preserve the wisdom and history of the nation.

text: Ithemba alibulali.
gloss: Hope does not kill.

text: Ọkùnrin tí mo rí lánàá ni olùkọ́ wa.
gloss: The man I saw yesterday is our teacher.

text: Ó mú ìwé wá.
gloss: He/she brought the book.

text: Mo gbé àpótí náà lọ sí ilé.
gloss: I carried the box to the house.

text: Ìwé ni mo rà, kì í ṣe aṣọ.
gloss: It was a book I bought, not clothes.

text: Ẹ jọ̀wọ́, ẹ ràn mí lọ́wọ́.
gloss: Please, help me.

text: Aṣọ rẹ̀ funfun báláú.
gloss: His/her cloth is spotlessly white.

text: Bí òjò bá rọ̀, a ò ní lọ.
gloss: If it rains, we will not go.

text: Ṣùgbọ́n ó yẹ kí a ṣe iṣẹ́ náà dáadáa.
gloss: But we ought to do the work well.

text: Lérò tèmi, ẹ̀kọ́ ọ̀fẹ́ ti ran ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ọmọdé lọ́wọ́.
gloss: In my opinion, free education has helped many children.

text: Mi ò rò pé ètò yìí máa ṣàṣeyọrí láìsí àtìlẹ́yìn àwọn aráàlú.
gloss: I don't think this plan will succeed without the citizens' support.

text: Mo fara mọ́ ọ̀rọ̀ rẹ díẹ̀, ṣùgbọ́n kì í ṣe pátápátá.
gloss: I agree with you a little, but not completely.

text: Ó dàbí ẹni pé owó oúnjẹ yóò máa lọ sókè lọ́dún yìí.
gloss: It seems food prices will keep rising this year.

text: Ó ṣe pàtàkì láti gbọ́ ẹ̀gbẹ́ méjèèjì kí a tó pinnu.
gloss: It is important to hear both sides before we decide.

text: Mo gbà pé ó yẹ kí àwọn ọ̀dọ́ ní àǹfààní púpọ̀ sí i nínú ìṣèjọba.
gloss: I believe young people should have more opportunity in governance.

text: Kì í ṣe òótọ́ pé ẹ̀rọ ìgbàlódé ń ba àṣà wa jẹ́.
gloss: It is not true that modern technology is ruining our culture.

text: Ọ̀rọ̀ rẹ yé mi, àmọ́ ó nílò ẹ̀rí sí i.
gloss: I understand your point, but it needs more evidence.

text: Akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ tí ó gba ẹ̀bùn ni àbúrò mi.
gloss: The student who won the prize is my younger sibling.

text: Ilé tí a kọ́ lọ́dún tó kọjá ti di títà.
gloss: The house we built last year has been sold.

text: Àwọn tí ń gbé ìlú ńlá ń san owó ilé púpọ̀.
gloss: Those who live in the city pay a lot of rent.

text: Ìwé tí o yá mi dùn ún kà gan-an.
gloss: The book you lent me is very enjoyable to read.

text: Ibi tí a ti pàdé lákọ̀ọ́kọ́ ti yí padà.
gloss: The place where we first met has changed.

text: Olùkọ́ tí ń kọ́ wa ní ìṣirò le díẹ̀.
gloss: The teacher who teaches us maths is a bit strict.

text: Ọjọ́ tí wọ́n bí i, òjò rọ̀ gan-an.
gloss: The day he was born, it rained heavily.

text: Ó gbé àga wá fún mi.
gloss: He brought a chair for me.

text: Mo ra ẹja jẹ.
gloss: I bought fish and ate it.

text: Wọ́n sáré lọ sí ọjà.
gloss: They ran to the market.

text: Ó fi ọ̀bẹ gé iṣu.
gloss: She cut the yam with a knife.

text: Ẹ bá mi gbé e lọ sílé.
gloss: Help me carry it home.

text: Ó mú ọmọ náà lọ sí ilé ìwòsàn.
gloss: She took the child to the hospital.

text: A fi owó náà ra ilẹ̀.
gloss: We used the money to buy land.

text: Tí o bá wá ní kùtùkùtù, a ó jọ lọ.
gloss: If you come early, we will go together.

text: Bí mo bá ní owó, màá ra oko.
gloss: If I have money, I will buy a farm.

text: Ká ní mo mọ̀ pé ara rẹ ò yá ni, ǹ bá wá kí ọ.
gloss: Had I known you were ill, I would have come to greet you.

text: Bí òjò bá rọ̀ lónìí, wọn ó sún ìpàdé síwájú.
gloss: If it rains today, the meeting will be postponed.

text: Tí o kò bá jẹun dáadáa, ara rẹ ò ní le.
gloss: If you don't eat well, you won't be strong.

text: Nígbà tí mo dé, wọ́n ti lọ.
gloss: When I arrived, they had gone.

text: Ó ń kàwé nígbà tí iná lọ.
gloss: He was reading when the power went off.

text: Kò tíì dé ilé.
gloss: He hasn't got home yet.

text: Mi ò tíì dé Ìbàdàn rí.
gloss: I have never been to Ibadan.

text: Àwọn àgbà máa ń jókòó sábẹ́ igi yìí nírọ̀lẹ́.
gloss: The elders usually sit under this tree in the evening.

text: A ti ń dúró fún wákàtí méjì.
gloss: We have been waiting for two hours.

text: Ìwọ ni mo ń wá.
gloss: It is you I am looking for.

text: Lánàá ni wọ́n dé.
gloss: It was yesterday that they arrived.

text: Owó ni ó fa ìjà náà.
gloss: It was money that caused the quarrel.

text: Ilé náà mọ́ tónítóní.
gloss: The house is spotlessly clean.

text: Aṣọ rẹ̀ pupa fòò.
gloss: Her cloth is bright red.

text: Ojú ọ̀run dúdú kirikiri.
gloss: The sky is pitch dark.

text: Ó ga gogoro.
gloss: He is very tall.

text: Omi náà tutù nini.
gloss: The water is ice cold.

text: Lákọ̀ọ́kọ́, ẹ jẹ́ ká wo ìṣòro náà.
gloss: First, let us look at the problem.

text: Yàtọ̀ sí ìyẹn, owó ọkọ̀ ti lọ sókè.
gloss: Besides that, transport fares have gone up.

text: Nítorí náà, a nílò ètò tuntun.
gloss: Therefore, we need a new plan.

text: Fún àpẹẹrẹ, ọ̀pọ̀ ilé ìwé kò ní ilé ìkàwé.
gloss: For example, many schools have no library.

text: Ní ọ̀nà mìíràn, àwọn òbí náà ní ojúṣe.
gloss: On the other hand, parents also have a responsibility.

text: Níkẹyìn, ìpàdé náà parí ní àlàáfíà.
gloss: Finally, the meeting ended peacefully.

text: Ẹ jọ̀wọ́, ẹ dákun, ẹ fún mi ní omi.
gloss: Please, kindly give me water.

text: Ẹ má bínú pé mo pẹ́.
gloss: Sorry that I am late.

text: Ẹ káàbọ̀, ẹ jókòó.
gloss: Welcome, please sit down.

text: Ẹ kú àṣẹ̀ṣẹ̀yọ ọdún.
gloss: Compliments on the new year.

text: Ẹ ṣé púpọ̀ fún ìtọ́jú yín.
gloss: Thank you very much for your care.

text: Ẹ kú ìrọ́jú, ẹ ò ní rí irú rẹ̀ mọ́.
gloss: Sorry for your loss; may you not see such again.

text: Mo fẹ́ béèrè fún iṣẹ́ tí wọ́n polówó rẹ̀ nínú ìwé ìròyìn.
gloss: I want to apply for the job advertised in the newspaper.

text: Mo ti ṣiṣẹ́ fún ọdún márùn-ún gẹ́gẹ́ bí akọ̀wé.
gloss: I have worked for five years as a clerk.

text: Owó oṣù mi kò tó láti san gbogbo owó tí mo jẹ.
gloss: My salary isn't enough to pay all my debts.

text: Ibà ti ń ṣe mí láti àná.
gloss: I have had a fever since yesterday.

text: Ẹ̀fọn ni ó ń fa àrùn ibà.
gloss: Mosquitoes cause malaria.

text: Ó dára láti máa mu omi púpọ̀ lójoojúmọ́.
gloss: It is good to drink plenty of water daily.

text: Gígé igi ti fa ọ̀gbẹlẹ̀ ní agbègbè yìí.
gloss: Tree felling has caused drought in this area.

text: Àgbàrá ti ba ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ oko jẹ́ lọ́dún yìí.
gloss: Floods have destroyed many farms this year.

text: Ní ọjọ́ kan, ọdẹ kan lọ sínú igbó ní òun nìkan.
gloss: One day, a hunter went into the forest alone.

text: Lójijì, ó gbọ́ ohùn àjèjì kan.
gloss: Suddenly, he heard a strange voice.

text: Ó gbìyànjú láti padà sílé ṣùgbọ́n ó ti sọnù.
gloss: He tried to go home but he was already lost.

text: Níkẹyìn, àwọn ará abúlé rí i.
gloss: In the end, the villagers found him.

text: Àwọn ọmọkùnrin máa ń dọ̀bálẹ̀ láti kí àgbà.
gloss: Boys prostrate to greet elders.

text: Àwọn ọmọbìnrin máa ń kúnlẹ̀ láti kí àgbà.
gloss: Girls kneel to greet elders.

text: A kì í fi ọwọ́ òsì gba nǹkan lọ́wọ́ àgbà.
gloss: One does not receive things from an elder with the left hand.

text: Ìsọmọlórúkọ máa ń wáyé ní ọjọ́ kẹjọ lẹ́yìn ìbí.
gloss: The naming ceremony takes place on the eighth day after birth.

text: A máa ń pe àgbà ní "ẹ" dípò "o".
gloss: Elders are addressed with "ẹ" instead of "o".

text: Ó fi ẹsẹ̀ fẹ.
gloss: He took to his heels.

text: Ọ̀rọ̀ náà wọ̀ ọ́ lára.
gloss: The words touched him deeply.

text: Ó ṣe ojú mi.
gloss: It happened in my presence.

text: Inú rẹ̀ dùn.
gloss: He is happy (lit. his inside is sweet).

text: Ó fi ojú di mí.
gloss: He looked down on me.

text: Ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ènìyàn gbàgbọ́ pé ẹ̀kọ́ ni ọ̀nà sí ìlọsíwájú.
gloss: Many people believe that education is the road to progress.

text: Nígbà tí ó dé ilé, ó rí i pé ilẹ̀kùn ti ṣí sílẹ̀.
gloss: When he got home, he saw that the door had been opened.

text: Ẹ kú iṣẹ́.
gloss: (Greeting to someone at work.)

text: Bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé ètò náà dára, ìmúṣẹ rẹ̀ kò lágbára.
gloss: Although the plan is good, its implementation is weak.

text: Ó hàn gbangba pé láìsí ẹ̀kọ́, ìlọsíwájú kò lè wà.
gloss: It is clear that without education there can be no progress.

text: Ìbéèrè pàtàkì kì í ṣe bóyá a nílò àyípadà, bí kò ṣe bí a ó ṣe mú un wá.
gloss: The key question is not whether we need change but how to bring it.

text: Bí ìjọba kò bá dẹ́kun ìwà ìbàjẹ́, àwọn aráàlú kò ní gbẹ́kẹ̀lé e mọ́.
gloss: If the government does not stop corruption, citizens will no longer trust it.

text: Pẹ̀lú gbogbo akitiyan tí a ti ṣe, èsì rẹ̀ kò tíì tẹ́ wa lọ́rùn.
gloss: Despite all the efforts made, the results have not yet satisfied us.

text: Ní èrò tèmi, ojútùú tó máa wà pẹ́ nílò ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀ gbogbo ènìyàn.
gloss: In my view, a lasting solution needs everyone's cooperation.

text: Bí o ṣe ń kàwé tó, bẹ́ẹ̀ ni òye rẹ yóò ṣe pọ̀ tó.
gloss: The more you read, the more your understanding grows.

text: A gbọ́dọ̀ kúrò kí òjò tó bẹ̀rẹ̀.
gloss: We must leave before the rain starts.

text: Wọ́n ní olóṣèlú náà fẹ́ kọ̀wé fipò sílẹ̀.
gloss: They say the politician wants to resign.

text: Kò sí ẹni tí ó mọ ohun tí ó ṣẹlẹ̀.
gloss: No one knew what had happened.

text: Ó ń sọ̀rọ̀ bí ẹni pé ọ̀mọ̀wé ni.
gloss: He talks as though he were an expert.

text: Ìgbà náà ni mo tó mọ̀ pé mo ti ṣàṣìṣe.
gloss: It was then I realised I had made a mistake.

text: Pẹ̀lú ọ̀wọ̀ àti ìtẹríba, mo fẹ́ fi ẹ̀bẹ̀ mi síwájú yín.
gloss: With respect and humility, I wish to present my request to you.

text: À ń fi tó yín létí pé ọ́fíìsì yóò wà ní títì ní ọjọ́ Ajé.
gloss: We hereby inform you that the office will be closed on Monday.

text: Lórúkọ ìgbìmọ̀, mo dúpẹ́ lọ́wọ́ yín tọkàntọkàn.
gloss: On behalf of the committee, I thank you sincerely.

text: Ẹ̀yin ọmọ ìlú, a péjọ síbí nítorí ọ̀rọ̀ pàtàkì kan.
gloss: Fellow citizens, we are gathered here for an important matter.

text: Ní òru ọjọ́ náà, gbogbo abúlé dákẹ́ rọ́rọ́.
gloss: That night, the whole village was completely silent.

text: Bàbá àgbà jókòó sí ìloro, ó ń ronú nípa ìgbà èwe rẹ̀.
gloss: The old man sat on the porch thinking about his youth.

text: Ó rántí bí ó ṣe kúrò ní abúlé láìní nǹkan kan.
gloss: He remembered how he left the village with nothing.

text: Ó wá mọ̀ pé owó kò lè ra àkókò tí ó ti sọnù.
gloss: He realised that money cannot buy lost time.

text: Òwe ni ẹṣin ọ̀rọ̀; bí ọ̀rọ̀ bá sọnù, òwe la fi ń wá a.
gloss: Proverbs are the horse of speech; when speech is lost, we use proverbs to find it.

text: Oríkì jẹ́ ewì tí a fi ń yin ènìyàn tàbí ìdílé.
gloss: Oríkì is praise poetry for a person or lineage.
